organization_id.description: Customer organization affected by this platform event, when applicable.

platform_admin_user_id.description: Platform administrator who performed the action, when the actor is a person.

support_access_session_id.description: Related SupportAccessSession record when this event concerns support access.

event_key.description: Stable event identifier, such as support_session_requested, support_session_started, entitlement_changed, or subscription_changed.

event_summary.description: Short human-readable description of what occurred. Do not include client-sensitive narrative content.

actor_type.description: Identifies whether the event was performed by an internal platform administrator or an automated platform process.

target_entity.description: Entity or platform resource affected by the action.

target_record_id.description: ID of the affected entity record, when applicable.

details.description: Structured, non-sensitive internal audit details. Never store CE client narratives, assessment answers, or documents here.

tenant_visible.description: Marks whether this event should appear in the future customer-facing support and security history.

occurred_at.description: ISO timestamp for when the event occurred.
